rachel_devex: Quick ping — noticed a small parity gap between ruby-sdk and go-client around retry/backoff for streaming requests when token refresh happens. Repro: hit streaming endpoint and rotate token mid-stream, ruby drops the stream, go transparently retries.

jonathan_rb: ugh. do you have a minimal repro or logs? I can take a look later today.

rachel_devex: repro gist here: https://gist.github.com/xxxx — basically: open streaming socket, then call API to rotate the API key for the user, ruby client raises EOFError. stack: `lib/redwood/stream.rb:42`

alex_engineer: quick glance — looks like our streaming loop doesn't re-create the HTTP connection on 401 during mid-stream. go's client retries at transport layer.

jonathan_rb: can you paste the loop? maybe we can patch with a `rescue EOFError, Errno::ECONNRESET` and trigger a reconnect + exponential backoff.

rachel_devex: snippet: ```ruby
while chunk = socket.readpartial(4096)
  handle(chunk)
rescue EOFError
  reconnect_with_backoff
end
```

alex_engineer: ^ that's the current pattern. I'm thinking instead: wrap streaming read in a loop that checks `auth.refresh_if_needed` on exceptions and then `next` to continue. Also ensure we don't double-yield partial events.

maya_support: fwiw, customers hit this in the sampleapp when rotating tokens from the UI. temporary workaround: restart the client process after rotation.

rachel_devex: opened PR 2345 with the minimal reconnect patch and added a unit test for mid-stream refresh: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2345

ci-bot: PR 2345 — CI: linux/arm64: passed, linux/x86_64: passed, macos: failed (bundle install error), windows: pending.

jonathan_rb: can someone reproduce the macos bundler failure locally? looks like CI noise — maybe a dev dependency pin.

alex_engineer: I saw that earlier — bundler 2.4 vs 2.3 quirk in the Gemfile.lock. I'll push a tiny lockfile update to the branch.

maya_support: also, can we add a small note in the sampleapp README about token rotation handling? ppl keep restarting instead of relying on client reconnect.

rachel_devex: good call. I'll add a short section in docs and include a changelog line. After alex's lockfile fix and green windows ci, i'll merge. :thumbsup:

jonathan_rb: add a brief integration test (non-flaky) and we should be good.

rachel_devex: noted — adding integration test that simulates rotation with a fake auth server. thanks all! :sparkles:
